# Feature: Meshy credits live refresh + larger spiral loader

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-18 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Meshy credit balance in the Character Editor (provider select + confirm dialog) must stay current after load, before confirm, and after a generation finishes. The cloudy-spiral generating animation must use a larger radius so it fills the preview card without UI jitter.

## Preconditions
- Character Editor open; avatar source Meshy; Meshy BYOK configured with a valid key.
- Edge `ai-provider-credentials` refresh action available.

## Happy Path
- [ ] Opening the Meshy panel (or selecting Meshy) shows credits from a live refresh, not only a stale `list` meta cache.
- [ ] Opening “KI-Generierung starten?” refreshes credits before showing “Verfügbar: …”.
- [ ] After a successful generation poll, provider select + balance reflect updated credits.
- [ ] Generating overlay spiral radius is visibly larger than the prior compact ring (still inside the 4:5 card, soft vignette edges).
- [ ] Overlay CSS remains module-static (no per-progress `<style>` rebuild); no animated `box-shadow`.

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Refresh failure → keep last known credits; do not block start/confirm.
- [ ] Provider without credits meta → no “· N Credits” suffix; modal omits or softens balance line as today.
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` still disables spiral motion.

## Regression
- [ ] Confirm modal still shows estimate + “Kein automatischer Paid-Retry”.
- [ ] `avatar-meshy-generation-check` PASS.
- [ ] Kong URL rewrite for Meshy modelUrl still present.

## Assumptions
- Live balance comes from existing `aiProviderCredentialsService.refresh(providerId)` (server validates key + fetches Meshy credits). No new Edge action.
- Larger radius stays GPU-cheap (no box-shadow revival; shallow Z retained).

- B-01/B-04: refresh still via authenticated Edge + owner-scoped BYOK ciphertext; client never sees raw key.
- Out of scope: B-07–B-10 (no permission-admin / workers).

## Composition Gate
- Producer: `refresh` Edge → consumer: `AvatarMeshyPanel` provider state (one SoT for credits meta).
- Invalid refresh fails closed to last known balance (no invented credits).
